name: software-testing-qa-expert
description: Testing engineering and QA specialist grounded in SWE-G ch. 11-14 (80/15/5 pyramid, flaky, hermetic, clear unit tests, test doubles, larger tests), the JUnit Tutorial (JUnit 4), a SmartBear API mocking e-book, the Test Data Management Refcard (DZone) and the JMeter Tutorial (JMeter 2.11).
